name: Waveshare ESP32-S3-AMOLED-1.91 / ESP32-S3-Touch-AMOLED-1.91
description: 1.91" 240x536 AMOLED (RM67162, QSPI), FT3168 touch, TF card, QMI8658C, battery sense.
verify: Pins from Waveshare's demo code and schematic (https://github.com/waveshareteam/ESP32-S3-AMOLED-1.91). 1) TF card. The published schematic (2024-11-27) ties the card to the AMOLED's own lines - SD_CLK = WRX_SCL (GPIO47), SD_MISO = SDO (GPIO8), SD_CS = TE (GPIO9), SD_MOSI = GP42 - which is the code's V1 branch (SPI3_HOST, MISO 8, MOSI 42, CLK 47, CS 9). The code's default, VersionControl_V2, is 1-bit SDMMC with CLK on GPIO9, which on that sheet is the card's CD/D3 pin. The glass has rounded corners whose radius Waveshare does not give, so the designer draws them square: keep what matters out of the corners, or set a corner radius on the Display tab once it is measured. Brightness is a command to the panel, not a backlight pin. Compiled; not run on a board here.
